full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II, EDSA, Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 146 S. 42010 ZIJ Engr. HOMER T. SAQUILAYAN Municipal Mayor Municipality of Imus, Province of Cavite Dear Mayor Saquilayan: This pertains to your letter appealing for "another round of review" the legal issues pertaining to Ordinance No. 2010-110 enacted by the Sangguniang Bayan of Imus, Cavite entitled 'An Ordinance Enacting Supplemental Appropriation in the Amount of Twenty One Million One Hundred Seventy Four Thousand Six Hundred Six Pesos and 23/100 (P 21,174,606.23), Otherwise Known as Supplemental Budget No. 01 of the Municipality of Imus for Calendar Year 2010'. Your query was "whether Ordinance No. 2010-110 duly passed by the Sangguniang Bayan of Imus, Cavite can be implemented or not, or should be declared inoperative and ineffective for being contrary to law and the Constitution?" On record was an Opinion rendered by Regional Director Josefina E. Castilla-Go, a fact which was likewise acknowledged in your letter, hence, the request for a "second review" by this Office. RD Castilla-Go opined that "the sangguniang panlalawigan is vested with review power over ordinance described above with the concomitant responsibility to declare the same as inoperative when falling short of requirements. In the instant case, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Cavite should have declared the same as inoperative in a manner provided hereinabove. Hence, absent such declaration the appropriations ordinance is still operative. " It is a settled rule that an ordinance duly passed and enacted enjoys the presumption of validity, unless declared otherwise.l An aggrieved party may question the constitutionality, validity, or legality of an ordinance by filing an appropriate action before the Regional Trial Court. Thus, finding no compelling reason to depart from the opinion already rendered by our Regional Office thru RD Castilla-Go, we AFFIRM the same with finality. Thank you for your continued trust and confidence. Very truly your , 60 TTY. JESUS B.
